result.question: What explanation did the old prophet give for the man of God's death?

readings.answer: Because he disobeyed the command of the LORD
readings.support: disobeyed the command of the LORD

readings.answer: The LORD delivered him to the lion
readings.support: Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion

readings.answer: He was mauled and killed by a lion
readings.support: it has mauled him and killed him

readings.answer: It happened according to the word the LORD had spoken
readings.support: according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him

assessments.reason: The prophet says, “It is the man of God who disobeyed the command of the LORD,” giving the cause, though it omits “Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion,” which the key includes.
“Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion” matches the prophet’s stated agency for the death, though it leaves out the stated cause of disobedience.
“It has mauled him and killed him” reports what happened, not the explanation for why he died, which the prophet frames with disobedience and the LORD delivering him to the lion.
“According to the word that the LORD had spoken to him” is part of the prophet’s explanation (it happened as foretold), though it does not include the cause-and-agency pair in the key.
